name: Spine Accordion
description: An expanding accordion for React built from tall spines with vertical titles: the open one widens into a coloured panel, its artwork glides out of the spine and grows into place, and the plus turns into an autoplay progress ring. Hover intent, keyboard and touch, stacked layout on narrow screens. Spring motion with Motion.

props.name: items
props.type: {title: string; description?: string; image?: string; imageAlt?: string; imageScale?: number; tone?: string; coverColor?: string; linkLabel?: string; href?: string; newTab?: boolean}[]
props.description: The panels. Artwork works best as a transparent PNG/WebP; tone is the open panel's colour, coverColor the spine's. With href the open panel is a link.

props.name: initialOpen
props.description: 1-based index of the panel open at start. 0 starts with everything closed (when collapsible).

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Clicking the open panel closes it.

props.name: hoverToOpen
props.description: A resting mouse opens a spine after a short intent delay. Touch always uses taps.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Moves to the next panel on a timer, with a progress ring and a pause button. Waits while the pointer is over it or it's off screen.

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds per panel when autoplay is on (min 2).

props.name: cardHeight
props.description: Panel height in the side-by-side layout, in px. Grows if the copy needs more room.

props.name: closedWidth
props.description: Width of a closed spine, in px.

props.name: mobileHeaderHeight
props.description: Header height of each row in the stacked layout, in px.

props.name: breakpoint
props.description: Container width (px) from which the spines sit side by side; narrower containers stack them.

props.name: minOpenWidth
props.description: Narrowest the open panel may get before the row scrolls sideways, in px.

props.name: artTravel
props.description: How far the artwork follows the pointer on the open panel, in px.

props.name: hoverMotion
props.description: Artwork floats, tilts and follows the pointer on the open panel.

props.name: textColor / secondaryColor / coverTextColor / focusColor
props.description: Text on the open panel, its description, text on the spines, and the keyboard focus ring.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It takes its parent's width.
